info.description: Generated from the live OpenAPI specs exposed by each service (/docs/<service>/v3/api-docs) via the gateway's local-profile-only docs routes (issue #169). Regenerate with `openapi-to-postmanv2 -s <spec>.json -o <out>.json -p` after pulling fresh specs from a locally running stack (SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=local on the gateway and the three backend services).
